newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products climb, gasoline $9 stronger.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products climb, gasoline $9 stronger.

text.p: NWE oil products firmed on Thursday, with gasoline rising $9 a tonne, traders said.

High sulphur fuel oil barges ended at the $97 mark with bunker demand and low prompt supply said to be propping up the market. Low sulphur barges were offered notionally as high as $99 fob but no buyers came into the market.
High sulphur cracked cargoes were steady to a touch stronger at $92/$95 for Russian material with buyers and sellers said to be sticking to their ground.

Gasoline was $9 a tonne stronger on a bullish cocktail of cracker problems in the U.S., tight local supplies and news Nigeria was likely to continue gasoline imports. Barges traded at $227 to $230 fob AR.
Gas oil climbed with September IPE, which ended $3.75 a tonne firmer at $173.75. Barges were inactive. Russian cargoes trade easier at a 50 cent and a 25 cent discount to the screen cif NWE.
